newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan approves NTT's international unit.
newsitem.headline: Japan approves NTT's international unit.

text.p: Japan on Thursday approved of Nippon Telegraph and Telephone Corp's plan to form a unit for international services on condition that the new unit is independent from the parent firm in certain areas to secure fair competition.
The Ministry of Posts and Telecommunications said in a statement that NTT executives and officials will not be allowed to concurrently serve as full-time executives of the new unit.
The government also urged NTT to make sure that the new unit's marketing and advertising operations are independent from the parent company's.
NTT has said in the past that it would form the wholly owned subsidiary, NTT Worldwide Telecommunications Corp, after receiving government approval.
The new company will begin international services for corporate clients in the autumn.
